mainTopic: How small a קומץ or הקטרה can be, and how many sets of lashes someone gets for burning שאור and דבש on the מזבח
overview: This amud finishes the argument between אביי and רבא about the size of a קומץ and the smallest amount that counts as a הקטרה. אביי holds that burning less than a כזית still counts. רבא holds that a קומץ is never less than two olives and that a burning needs at least a כזית. Then the גמרא brings a second argument between them. If someone offers a mixture of שאור and דבש on the מזבח, רבא says he gets four sets of lashes: for שאור, for דבש, for mixtures of שאור, and for mixtures of דבש. אביי says there are no lashes for a לאו שבכללות, one לאו that covers many acts. The גמרא then brings two reports of what אביי means. One says he still gets one set of lashes. The other says he gets none at all, because lashes are learned from the לאו of muzzling an ox, which forbids one specific act.

steps.title: אביי: burning less than an olive still counts
steps.stepSummary: אביי's view ends with the rule that burning less than a כזית still counts as an act of הקטרה.
steps.simpleTranslation: And there is such a thing as a burning that is less than an olive-size.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא is finishing אביי's opinion. He holds that offering even less than a כזית on the מזבח still counts as a real burning.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Because אביי holds that a burning of less than a כזית counts, the word 'any' in the פסוק about שאור can teach that a person is liable even for burning a tiny amount of שאור. This sets up רבא's opposite view in the next step.

keyTerms.meaning: Burning an offering on the מזבח
The size of an olive, the usual smallest amount that counts in הלכה

phrases.english: And there is a burning less than an olive-bulk.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Finishes אביי's position from the earlier part of the sugya.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to אביי, burning less than a כזית counts as a real הקטרה in הלכה.

steps.title: רבא: a handful is at least two olives, and burning needs an olive
steps.stepSummary: רבא disagrees. A קומץ is never smaller than two olives, and burning less than a כזית does not count.
steps.simpleTranslation: And רבא said: There is no קומץ that is less than two olive-bulks, and there is no burning that is less than an olive-bulk.
steps.whatsHappening: רבא gives the opposite view from אביי on both points. A קומץ always holds at least two olives, and burning less than a כזית is not a real burning.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Since רבא holds that burning less than a כזית does not count, he cannot read 'any שאור' as including a tiny amount. So for him the word 'any' must teach something else, such as a case where only half of the קומץ is שאור.

keyTerms.meaning: The handful of a מנחה that the כהן takes and burns on the מזבח

steps.whatToRemember: אביי: a קומץ can be less than two olives, and a burning of less than a כזית counts. רבא: a קומץ is at least two olives, and a burning needs at least a כזית.
steps.confusionAlert: There are two separate measurements here: the size of the whole קומץ (two olives) and the smallest amount that counts as a burning (one olive). Do not mix them up.

phrases.english: There is no handful less than two olive-bulks,
and there is no burning less than an olive-bulk.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְרָבָא אָמַר: אֵין קוֹמֶץ פָּחוֹת מִשְּׁנֵי זֵיתִים
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the opposite opinion to אביי's view in step 1.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבא, a קומץ is at least two olives, and a burning of less than a כזית does not count.

steps.title: רבא: four sets of lashes for offering leaven and honey
steps.stepSummary: A new argument. Someone who offers שאור and דבש on the מזבח gets four sets of lashes according to רבא.
steps.simpleTranslation: It was said: If someone offers שאור and דבש on the מזבח, רבא said: He gets lashes for שאור, lashes for דבש, lashes for mixtures of שאור, and lashes for mixtures of דבש.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא starts a new argument between אביי and רבא. רבא says a person who offers a mixture of שאור and דבש gets four separate sets of lashes.
steps.deeperAnalysis: The פסוק says 'For any שאור and any דבש, you shall not burn any of it' (ויקרא 2:11). רבא reads it as four separate לאוים: plain שאור, plain דבש, mixtures of שאור, and mixtures of דבש. Each one gets its own set of lashes.

keyTerms.meaning: Sourdough leaven, which may not be offered on the מזבח
Honey or a sweet fruit syrup, which may not be offered on the מזבח
He is flogged, meaning he gets lashes from בית דין

phrases.english: It was stated: One who offers up from leaven and from honey
Rava said: He is flogged because of leaven,
and he is flogged because of honey,
he is flogged because of mixtures of leaven,
and because of mixtures of honey.

steps.triggerLanguage: אִיתְּמַר: הַמַּעֲלֶה מִשְּׂאוֹר וּמִדְּבַשׁ עַל גַּבֵּי הַמִּזְבֵּחַ
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Opens a new argument between the same two אמוראים on the same פסוק.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to רבא, offering a mixture of שאור and דבש brings four sets of lashes.

steps.title: אביי: no lashes for a general prohibition
steps.stepSummary: אביי disagrees with רבא's four sets of lashes, because this is a לאו שבכללות. The next two steps bring two reports of exactly what he means.
steps.simpleTranslation: אביי said: We do not give lashes for a לאו שבכללות.
steps.whatsHappening: אביי argues with רבא. He says there are no lashes for a לאו שבכללות, one לאו that covers many different acts, so the four sets of lashes do not apply.
steps.deeperAnalysis: For אביי, the single לאו 'you shall not burn' covers שאור, דבש and their mixtures all together. A לאו like this, which bundles several acts, is a לאו שבכללות, so it cannot bring four separate sets of lashes. The גמרא next brings two reports on whether one set still remains (step 5) or none at all (step 6).

keyTerms.meaning: A general prohibition: one לאו that covers many different forbidden acts

steps.whatToRemember: רבא: four sets of lashes (שאור, דבש, mixtures of שאור, mixtures of דבש). אביי: not four sets, because it is a לאו שבכללות. Whether he still gives one set is argued in the next two steps.
steps.whyThisMatters: The rule of לאו שבכללות appears all over ש״ס. It decides when a single לאו brings lashes and when it does not.

phrases.english: One is not flogged for a general prohibition.

steps.triggerLanguage: אַבָּיֵי אָמַר: אֵין לוֹקִין עַל לָאו שֶׁבִּכְלָלוֹת
steps.relationToPreviousStep: Gives the opposite opinion to רבא's four sets of lashes.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to אביי, lashes are not given for a לאו שבכללות, so רבא's four separate sets of lashes do not apply.

steps.title: One report: אביי agrees to at least one set of lashes
steps.stepSummary: Some say that even אביי agrees the offender gets at least one set of lashes.
steps.simpleTranslation: There are those who say: at any rate, he gets one set of lashes.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings one report of אביי's view. In this report, אביי only rejects the many sets of lashes, but he agrees there is at least one.
steps.deeperAnalysis: רבא gave four sets of lashes. In this report, אביי's complaint about a לאו שבכללות only stops the lashes from being multiplied. It does not cancel the lashes completely.

phrases.english: at any rate, he is flogged with one set of lashes.

steps.relationToPreviousStep: Narrows אביי's statement in step 4 so that it only rejects the extra sets of lashes.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to this report, אביי agrees that the offender gets at least one set of lashes.

steps.title: Second report: no lashes at all, since the prohibition is not specific
steps.stepSummary: Others say אביי gives no lashes at all, because a לאו that is not specific is not like the לאו of muzzling.
steps.simpleTranslation: And there are those who say: he is not flogged even once, because his prohibition is not specific, like the prohibition of muzzling.
steps.whatsHappening: The גמרא brings the second report of אביי's view. Here אביי holds that the offender gets no lashes at all, and the גמרא gives the reason.
steps.deeperAnalysis: Lashes are learned from the לאו of muzzling an ox, which forbids one specific act. A לאו that covers several things at once, like שאור and דבש together, is not similar to it. So this לאו brings no lashes at all.

keyTerms.meaning: The prohibition against muzzling an ox while it threshes, which is the model for when lashes are given
Specific, aimed at one single matter

steps.whatToRemember: There are two reports of אביי's view. In one, there is at least one set of lashes. In the other, there are no lashes at all, because a לאו must be specific like the לאו of muzzling.
steps.whyThisMatters: This step shows the basic rule behind a לאו שבכללות. Lashes are only given for a לאו that looks like the לאו of muzzling, which forbids one clear act.

phrases.english: And there are those who say,
he is not flogged even one set of lashes,
because his prohibition is not specific
phrases.notes: The single לאו here covers both שאור and דבש together, so it is not aimed at one thing.
דברים 25:4. That פסוק forbids one specific act, and lashes are learned from it.

steps.triggerLanguage: וְאִיכָּא דְּאָמְרִי, חֲדָא נָמֵי לָא לָקֵי
steps.relationToPreviousStep: A second report of אביי's view that disagrees with step 5 and removes even the one set of lashes.
steps.mimraCoreRuling: According to this report, אביי gives no lashes at all, since the לאו is not specific like the לאו of muzzling.
